evidence_contract.negative_control: attempt-f13-002-negative-tamper + attempt-f13-003-negative-wrongtag: GCM rejects tampered ciphertext and wrong tag/IV — the discriminator is sound
evidence_contract.positive_control: attempt-f13-004-replay + oracle-calibration: correct public-only material decrypts all three blobs reproducibly; sha256 matches across four independent runs
evidence_contract.replay: four independent fresh-process decryptions (orchestrator x2, independent verifier, kill-pair establish/kill) produce identical sha256 values
